name: THE BOARDING HOUSE WOMAN
note: Doc 07 #14-15, the one doc 07 marks A. The two run the only solvent business in town and regard the gold rush as a temporary weather event. Errata 183: they stand together at the right of their parlour (Room 37), where the composition master stood them. TALK TO either opens the one tree, and they answer as doc 07 writes them.
greetsWithBarkNote: As the boundary men: TALK TO opens with the pair's bark for the current reputation, in both voices.
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO THEM: beside them at their own depth, left of A, clear of her and of the tea table (doc 55 section 8; Tyler's boundary-men ruling, errata 167).

sprite.note: Frames 0-1 are the idle: the rest pose and its breath. Frame 2 is her action. Frame 3 is talking. The two break half a cycle apart.
sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, hands folded · 1 breath · 2 a hand to her pinned hair · 3 talking, a palm turned up.
sprite.statureNote: ERRATA 235 (Tyler, 2026-11-09: everyone within 3% of Thad). Stature 0.98: a woman a little under Thad, inside the 3% (was 0.97: 0.969 of Thad).
sprite.levelManNote: ERRATA 235: the man its sheet was snapped to one level at (errata 112 G), kept while it is drawn at its new height without a re-snap; the drift is held to 5% (tests/one-level.test.mjs).
sprite.figureHeightNote: 0.97 of the room's man at her feet, crown to sole, as the master drew them: cut and snapped there by tools/art/interiors-people.py (errata 112's one level).
sprite.breakEveryNote: Errata 296 (Tyler, 2026-11-12, on the map seller: "doesn't appear to have any movements"): one held pose every 17 s read as standing still. Now every 12 s.
